shared_elements: rounded or circular form (relief spiral vs. circular rim)
justification: A shows a panel of curvilinear relief carvings — concentric spiral/eye-like motifs and rounded figural forms crowded over a boulder face — while B shows a plain cylindrical basin with no depicted imagery at all beyond a faint incised line below its rim. The only correspondence is the generic presence of a rounded/circular contour in carved stone, which no shared iconographic tradition is needed to explain.
